context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren prepare for interviews.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; vocabulary (面接/会う/社内/歓迎/つながり) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来週、面接で候補者と会う。
lines.en: Next week we'll meet candidates in interviews.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 五名と会う。社内で行う予定だ。
lines.en: We'll meet five. We'll hold it in-house.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社内の雰囲気も、伝えたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to convey the in-house atmosphere too.
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、温かく歓迎しよう。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 面接で、人とのつながりを見たいです。
lines.en: In the interview, I want to see how they connect with people.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内のつながりも、紹介しよう。
lines.en: Let's introduce our in-house connections too.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歓迎の準備を、進めます。
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
